name: Under The Cherry Blossom Tree
source:
You're living the dream. You have friends, good grades, and an adorable shy boyfriend who loves you quite literally to death.

[Edited from [url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/under-the-cherry-blossom-tree]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正过着梦寐以求的生活：有好友相伴，成绩优异，还有一个害羞可爱、字面意义上“爱你爱到要你命”的男朋友。

[摘自[url=https://lifecrises.itch.io/under-the-cherry-blossom-tree]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
